title: 5 Signs
You're Not Done

post.title: 5 Signs You're Not Done Changing #shorts
post.description: How many did you check? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who checked all five. June finds her old diary and cringes at every page. Old photos, an embarrassing school playlist, an old best friend who feels like a stranger, the coffee you swore you'd never drink, and the feeling that this version of you is the final one. In 'The End of History Illusion' (Science, 2013), Jordi Quoidbach, Daniel Gilbert and Timothy Wilson asked more than 19,000 people aged 18 to 68 about their personalities, values and preferences. At every age, people reported changing a lot over the past ten years but expected to change much less over the next ten. Future you will probably cringe at today, and that's growth. #psychology #shorts #endofhistoryillusion #overthinking #selfgrowth
